verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents Smart Retries, which automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments to prevent involuntary churn. Its recovery analytics report failure and recovery rates, so recovery can be measured. However, the evidence never states that the retry cadence is ML-driven or schedule-optimized, so that part rests only on the feature name. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the ML or optimized retry cadence and configurable schedules, independent or hands-on evidence of measured churn recovery.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn

citations.quote: Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
Recovery analytics: Analyze subscription payment failure rates, recovery rates, and recent failed payments for top customers.
